## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher's 8 attempts break the project's 3-attempt retry cap, and the exemption this pull request adds for itself does not lift that rule, so the cap or the policy change should be settled first. The fetcher also does not retry a connection dropped mid-body, which is the failure it was written for.

## Changes
Adds `app/legacy/fetch.py` (inventory fetch, up to 8 attempts) and `app/health.py` (health probe, up to 3 attempts), with parametrized tests for both in `tests/test_retries.py`. Adds a sentence to `docs/review-rules.md` exempting modules under `app/legacy/` from the retry cap.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy fetch retries at 3 attempts — With the upstream down, `fetch_inventory` makes 8 attempts, breaking "Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts." (`docs/review-rules.md:5`, applied through `AGENTS.md:3`). The exemption at `docs/review-rules.md:7` is added by this pull request, so it does not lift the rule. — Each call can hold a worker thread for up to 87 seconds (8 ten-second timeouts plus 7 one-second delays) while the legacy service is down. — Fix: Set `MAX_ATTEMPTS` to 3 and update the hardcoded 8 at `tests/test_retries.py:10`, or land the exemption as a separately approved policy change before this code.
- app/legacy/fetch.py:24 — correctness — Retry http.client.IncompleteRead on mid-body drops — When the legacy service closes the connection after sending headers with a Content-Length, `resp.read()` raises `http.client.IncompleteRead`, which is not an `OSError`, so `fetch_inventory` fails on the first attempt. The description says the retries exist because the service "drops connections during its nightly restart"; `app/health.py:24` has the same handler. — A connection closed mid-body during the nightly restart fails the fetch immediately instead of being retried. — Fix: Catch `http.client.IncompleteRead` alongside `OSError` and extend `tests/test_retries.py` with that case.
